name: loan-origination-parity
description: UK loan origination workbench: one domain engine, four surfaces, one Serenity/JS Screenplay harness.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:core && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
